title: Test Suites Task: Evaluation of Gender Fairness in MT with MuST-SHE and INES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation models on specialized test suites (MuST-SHE and INES) by computing Term Coverage, Gender Accuracy for feminine and masculine translations, and an Inclusivity Index to measure the generation of gender-inclusive language versus non-inclusive masculine defaults.
